responsibility: Defines small reusable HIR mixin classes for carrying Rust attribute vectors on lowered nodes. `WithOuterAttrs` and `WithInnerAttrs` encapsulate ownership and access to `AST::AttrVec` for node classes that need outer or inner attributes, giving the HIR item and block structures a common storage convention for attribute metadata preserved from AST lowering rather than re-declaring that state in each concrete node type.
